description: This Java class defines a utility for wrapping signals into hashable envelopes for routing in a concierge service system. It provides a method to encapsulate signals with a computed hash key based on entity ID and resource type.

classes.name: ConciergeWrapper
classes.description: Utility class for wrapping signals into consistent hashable envelopes for routing.

methods.name: wrapForEnforcerRouter
methods.description: Wraps a Signal object into a ConsistentHashableEnvelope with a hash key derived from entity ID and resource type.

methods.name: hashFor
methods.description: Generates a hash string based on the resource type and entity ID of the given Signal.
